subject: Audit task lifecycle control: merged tasks must promote to done
description: Investigate the observed state split where claude/on-arm-grader-retrieval-production-identical-via-subconscious-search-context shows merge metadata as merged while lifecycle status remains ready. Trace the lifecycle control path across worker complete, same-node review approval, merge_attempt/headless merge finalization, overlay-sync/status derivation, checkpoint/frontier/dashboard projection, and claim files. Deliver a concise root-cause report plus minimal fix plan; implement only if the fix is small and clearly safe, otherwise report exact files/functions and tests needed.

summary: Audited same-node review/merge lifecycle and committed c0f876adc. Root cause: findReviewMergeCandidates only considered tested rows, so if /git/merge stamped merge_state/git.merged as merged but promote-to-done failed or was missed, the task could project as ready plus merged and the drain would skip repair forever. Fix: allow promote-only recovery for approved ready rows only when lifecycle.merge_state is already merged; pending ready rows still cannot be merged. Files changed: lib/headless-drain.js, test/headless-drain.test.js. Tests: node test/headless-drain.test.js; node test/review-lifecycle.test.js. Advisory git claim acquire failure appears separate from the lifecycle bug: the execution permit was active, and the bug is in post-merge status finalization/recovery rather than claim acquisition.
